name: zsnd_fade_lists_init_globals
description: zSndFadeLists::InitGlobals allocates and initializes the active and dispatch intrusive fade-list sentinels.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification was attempted with vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob2_facs, and vc5_o2_ob2_gx_facs; the closest completed profile was vc5_o2_ob2_facs with 46 unmasked mismatches.
tier S remains open because source helper shape and sentinel allocation/publish ordering do not yet reproduce the original static-init style codegen.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a3940 allocates two 12-byte zSndFadeListNode sentinels, points each sentinel's next and prev fields at itself, publishes the active and dispatch sentinel globals, and zeros both counts.
The native init/shutdown smoke verifies InitGlobals creates both empty sentinel rings with zero counts before ShutdownAtExit drains and deletes them.
